newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quiet after IPE expiry and losses.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quiet after IPE expiry and losses.

text.p: October Brent futures were unquoted at midday on Friday, with traders uncertain of market direction.
September Brent on IPE had risen 20 cents per barrel to to expire at $19.19 on Thursday.
But October Brent on IPE fell by 10 cents to $19.06, as speculative buying eased.
IPE Brent had been pushed up on Wednesday on increased buying, as news of a catalytic cracker shutdown at Exxon's Baytown, Texas refinery boosted gasoline prices.
Despite the weaker IPE, Singapore brokers said that the market was still looking at potentially higher prices, as there was limited selling, while interest to buy was quite healthy.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded $20.02, softer after New York's lost 11 cents to settle at $20.08.
